name: Display name
noVoice: No Arabic voice on this device, and fewer than 4 words have recorded audio.
voiceNote: Recorded audio is used where available; otherwise your device’s voice, which may mispronounce words.
question.pic: Which Arabic word matches the picture?
xpEarned: XP earned (reward points, not your score)
confirmDelete: Delete this learner and all their progress? This cannot be undone.
importFail: That file is not valid learner data.
storageError: Could not save to this browser. Progress will not be kept.
offline: You are offline. Saved lessons still work.
localNote: Profiles are stored only on this device. They are not secure accounts.
review.note: Original six themes migrated from version 1; Arabic still awaiting scholar review.
noJoin: This letter does not join to the letter after it.
letterNote: Letter names are standard; recorded sounds are not added yet.
question.lletter: What is the name of this letter?
completeNote: Complete means you finished the lesson. Mastery comes from practice scores.
posQ1: Which form is the {pos} form of {name}?
builderIntro: Build Arabic sentences from word tiles
alsoOk: Arabic also allows another word order here; we practise the order shown.
listeningIntro: Hear a word, then choose it
listenQ: Listen, then choose the word you heard.
listenNote: The lab generates spoken Arabic from the written words using your device’s text-to-speech engine. Pronunciation and voice quality depend on the device and installed Arabic voice; this is not a teacher recording.
writingIntro: Trace letters and words with your finger
traceNote: The app cannot judge stroke order or letter shape. Compare your tracing with the guide yourself, and ask a teacher or use a handwriting book for correct stroke order.
traceCanvas: Tracing area (draw with finger or mouse)
centreIntro: See progress for the learners on this device and set tasks. Everything stays on this device: there is no online account or sync, and no password protects this area.
summaryLine: {n} of {m} lessons complete · {x} XP · last active {d}
reportNote: Generated on this device from locally stored progress. It has not been verified by any server.
weakLessons: Lessons with a practice score below 70%
certIntro: A certificate is earned by completing every lesson in a set and passing each lesson’s practice with 70% or more.
certCompleted: has completed all lessons and passed each practice in
certFoot: Issued by the Kalimāti app on this device from the learner’s recorded progress. It is not an accredited qualification.
copyIntro: Type the Arabic sentence you see
writingNote: The app only checks for required words and sentence count. It cannot check grammar or spelling. Compare your writing with the model and ask a teacher.
adminIntro: Control certificates, pictures, audio, backups and which activities learners see. Everything here is stored on this device only.
pinNote: A PIN keeps children out of the Admin and Parent & teacher areas. It is not strong protection: anyone who knows how to use the browser’s developer tools can bypass it.
pinNeedsHttps: A PIN needs a secure (https) page.
imgNoteDevice: Images chosen here are saved on this device only. To use them on every device, upload logo.png, signature.png and stamp.png to assets/branding in the repository.
picNote: Choose a photo for each word from your phone. Photos are saved on this device only. To use them on every device, upload them to assets/images/vocab as <word-id>.jpg and list them in content/images/manifest.json (use the check button below to build that list).
audioNote: Recorded audio is played from assets/audio/<id>.mp3 for the words, letters and reading lines listed in content/audio/manifest.json. Without a file, the device’s Arabic voice is used if there is one.
restoreFail: That file is not a valid backup.
aboutLine: Kalimāti al-Ūlā version {v} · {n} learners on this device
audioFail: The audio could not be played. Check the file or try again.
aiVoiceNote: This is an AI-generated voice and has not been checked by a teacher.
voiceHelp: To use your device’s Arabic voice: open Android Settings, search for “Text-to-speech output”, choose Google Speech Services, then Install voice data and pick Arabic. Menu names vary by phone.
noAudioWord: There is no recorded audio for this item and this device has no Arabic voice.
listeningTtsReady: This lab uses your device’s built-in Arabic text-to-speech voice. No recordings are required.
listeningTtsUnavailable: This browser does not support speech playback. Try opening the app in Chrome on Android.
